rca of the issue: Original Iteration-2 defect RCA: PopoverTrigger was an empty <span/> opened programmatically while Radix Select's portal was unmounting — focus/portal race closed the popover before mount commit. Fix applied (this iteration): RangePicker.jsx now uses shadcn Dialog (modal, no anchor) and `setTimeout(() => setOpen(true), 50)` inside handleSelect to defer the open past the Select's portal teardown. Verified: dialog renders, inputs are focusable/fillable, Apply submits expected query params, dialog unmounts cleanly. Mitigation note: 50ms is a heuristic; if the Select unmount timing changes, prefer chaining on the Select's onCloseAutoFocus / SelectContent unmount lifecycle for a deterministic handoff.
